Committee: Economic Development and Tourism
Sponsor: Ball
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 04/19/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 613 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) Board by a small undetermined amount to include a designation on alcoholic manufacturer licenses that indicates the type of alcohol manufactured. This bill would not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Becky Nordgren, Chair
Economic Development and Tourism
